evidence.title: Tata Investment shares zoom 5 % as Tata Capital eyes $11 billion valuation for IPO
evidence.text: Tata Investment, a holding company with stakes across several Tata Group entities, is seen as a major indirect beneficiary of the IPO move. Market participants view the listing as a potential value-unlocking event for Tata Group’s broader financial services portfolio. As ET reported earlier, Tata Capital Ltd.’s IPO could raise as much as $2 billion. However, considerations are underway and details could change. Last week, Tata Capital's board approved the listing of up to 230 million shares, accompanied by an offer for sale of equity by existing shareholders. Additionally, the company announced a rights issue worth up to Rs 15.04 billion ($172 million). The Tata Capital IPO will mark the conglomerate’s second public market debut in two decades, following the successful listing of Tata Technologies in November 2023. Tata Sons, the holding company of the group, currently owns a 93% stake in Tata Capital. Serving a strategic function, Tata Capital fulfills the funding requirements of various group entities and operates across multiple segments, including personal loans, investment banking, and advisory services. Its key subsidiaries include Tata Capital Financial Services and Tata Capital Housing Finance.
